offers.sn: We are looking for a Network & Systems Administrator to join our IT Infrastructure team.
offers.rq: Minimum 3 years of experience in Network and Systems Administration. English proficiency (minimum B2); French (A2–B1) is an advantage.

offers.t: IT Systems Administrator & Internal Software Engineer
offers.sn: About the role: This is not a help-desk seat and it is not a junior cloud role.
offers.rq: Provide support to the entire company across four countries and multiple languages, escalating to no one because you are the escalation point. 5+ years operating simultaneously as a systems administrator, cloud engineer, network engineer, security practitioner, and software developer. Not sequentially. Romanian and English required.
